one_line: Field commander of the Maratha forces at the Battle of Kharda, 1795 CE.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, lean and wiry with a seasoned soldier’s build
appearance.face: Oval face with a sharp jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, high straight nose, neatly groomed black moustache with slightly upturned ends, faint scar along the right cheek, default expression calm but intensely focused with narrow, determined eyes
appearance.hair: Black hair kept short and tidy, mostly hidden beneath a deep-saffron Maratha-style turban tightly wrapped with a small forward-tilted peak and a narrow dark-red cloth band around its base
appearance.costume: He wears a quilted white cotton angarkha (cross-over coat) that reaches just below the knee, lightly padded and vertically stitched, with a high round collar and tied on the right side with thin cords, over a fitted long-sleeved pale-cream cotton tunic; a broad deep-saffron cotton patka (waist sash) is wrapped twice around his waist with the ends hanging neatly on the left, and over this he wears a simple brown leather belt holding a scabbard; his lower garments are narrow white cotton churidar-style trousers tightly ruched at the ankles, tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; over his torso he has a sleeveless dark-brown leather jerkin reinforced with small metal studs, cut to show the angarkha beneath, and his shoulders bear a plain steel pauldron on the left side only, strapped across the chest with a brown leather harness; he has minimal jewellery—small simple gold studs in both ears and a thin black-thread armlet on his right bicep—along with a narrow tilak of red kumkum on his forehead just under the turban edge; textiles are plain and practical, with only a subtle thin red border on the angarkha and a faint woven pattern on the patka.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Maratha talwar with a steel hilt and disc pommel, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard with a subtle brass chape and always worn at his left hip, often drawn and held in a ready, low-guard stance.

ref_desc: Parshuram Bhau Patwardhan is a lean early-forties Maratha commander with a deep-saffron turban, short black hair, neat upturned moustache and cheek scar, wearing a white quilted angarkha, dark-brown studded leather jerkin, saffron sash, white churidars, brown boots and carrying a curved talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Parshuram Bhau Patwardhan as a heroic late-18th-century Maratha commander in the Deccan: a lean, early-forties man with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, high nose, narrow intense eyes, a neat black moustache with slightly upturned ends and a faint scar on his right cheek, hair cut short under a deep-saffron Maratha turban wrapped tightly with a small forward peak and a narrow dark-red band at its base. Show him in a white quilted cotton angarkha that falls just below the knee, lightly padded with vertical stitching, edged in a thin red border and tied on the right side, over a fitted pale-cream long-sleeved tunic. Wrap a broad deep-saffron cotton patka twice around his waist with the ends hanging on the left, over which sits a brown leather belt that supports a plain brown leather scabbard with a brass chape. Add a sleeveless dark-brown leather jerkin, reinforced with small metal studs, worn over his torso and cut so the angarkha shows beneath, plus a single plain steel pauldron on his left shoulder held by a brown leather harness across his chest. His lower body has narrow white churidar trousers ruched at the ankles and tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots. Include small gold stud earrings, a thin black-thread armlet on his right bicep, and a narrow red tilak just under the turban edge. Place his curved steel talwar in the scabbard at his left hip, and in an alternate pose show it drawn and held in a low ready guard, emphasizing the steel-grey blade and disc pommel. Use a restrained palette of deep saffron, white, dark brown, pale cream and steel grey, and show front, side and rear views to clearly present his consistent face, turban, clothing, armour, boots and weapon.
